meta.name: starmetal_crater
meta.prompt: A market town grown around a crashed star-metal meteorite half-buried in its central square, still glowing in its crater, with the smiths' forges ringed around the rim.

programs.brief: A colossal jagged celestial meteorite of black meteoric iron, crying obsidian, and radiant crystalline star-metal veins glowing with purple and cyan heat, half-buried nose-down in the impact crater with fracture crusts flaring outward.
A smoking cluster of star-metal slag and glowing amethyst and copper crystal shards embedded into the churned ground.

tokens.terrain: a market town arranged radially around a central impact crater holding a glowing star-metal meteorite half-buried in the ground
tokens.icons: a half-buried star-metal meteorite glowing in the central crater; smithies, smelting hearths, and forges ringed directly around the rim; market stalls and trader wagons filling the adjoining avenues
